methodology: Amounts are operating exposure percentages and holding-weighted operating stress contributions, never predicted stock returns or portfolio P&L. Holding weights are fractions of NAV, including shorts; they are never renormalized.

Disclosed applies only to sourced direct exposure. Every scenario impact, country/product intersection, aggregate-region allocation and multi-hop percentage is an estimate. Chained percentages assume proportional transmission; no calibrated market beta is used.

Each denominator basis and reporting period is kept separate. Disjoint validated SEG partitions add; otherwise overlap bounds use the largest lower bound and the capped sum of upper bounds. Different scenario shocks are reported separately and must not be added without an overlap model.

Country and counterparty shocks scale disclosed operating shares proportionally to the assumed shock. Commodity prices, tariffs, rates and FX need a sourced sensitivity or an explicit user transmission assumption to quantify an operating impact. Revenue geography is not import origin, invoicing currency or production location.

Profile domicile identifies a location association only. Missing percentages, anonymous entities, truncated graphs, outdated sources, unknown hedges, substitute suppliers and undisclosed relationships limit coverage. No relationship found never means zero exposure.

Latest available observations only. Source filing dates and periods accompany evidence; SEG may reflect a later restatement and does not support point-in-time backtesting. Ranges describe disclosure overlap and explicit assumptions, not statistical confidence intervals.
